descripcion: Stationary vehicles as obstacles (with their doors, tailgates, ramps and overhangs), trailers, skips and site machinery, and what you find in a car park and a filling station: bays, wheel stops, barriers, payment, car wash and air.

categorias.plazas: Bays, wheel stops and car park ground
categorias.gasolinera: Filling station, car wash and air

todoterreno_alto.descripcion: Big, tall off-roader. The bonnet is chest high and the wing mirrors are at shoulder height; there is a lot of clearance underneath and the cane reaches in as far as the wheels.
todoterreno_alto.imagen: Footprint of “Tall off-roader”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.98 by 4.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

camioneta_caja_abierta.descripcion: Truck with a cab at the front and, behind it, a sheet-metal load bed open at the top, its edge at chest height. The tailgate may be down, sticking out a good hand's length.
camioneta_caja_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Pick-up truck”: a long box at the back and a slightly narrower cab at the front, 1.95 by 5.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

cuadriciclo.descripcion: A very small, narrow plastic car: it sounds hollow when touched. It fits crossways in a bay and is sometimes parked on the pavement.
cuadriciclo.imagen: Footprint of “Light quadricycle”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.50 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cu”.

taxi_parado.nombre: Taxi waiting with its engine running
taxi_parado.descripcion: Taxi waiting with its engine idling: you hear it purring from a few metres away. The rear door is on the side; pull the handle to open it.
taxi_parado.imagen: Footprint of “Taxi waiting with its engine running”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.82 by 4.65 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

coche_electrico_cargando.descripcion: Electric car plugged in. There is no engine noise: only a faint hum from the charger. A thick cable runs from its side to the post.
coche_electrico_cargando.imagen: Footprint of “Electric car charging”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.85 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

cable_recarga_suelo.descripcion: Thick rubber cable crossing the path from the charging post to the car. It does not block the way, but feet and cane catch on it.
cable_recarga_suelo.aviso: Cable on the ground: lift your feet.
cable_recarga_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Charging cable on the ground”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 2.50 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

porton_trasero_abierto.descripcion: The raised tailgate of a people carrier or an SUV: a sheet of metal and glass jutting backwards at forehead height. The cane passes underneath without touching it.
porton_trasero_abierto.imagen: Footprint of “Open tailgate”: a rectangle, 1.30 by 1.00 metres, hanging 1.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pt”.

puerta_coche_abierta.nombre: Car door open over the pavement
puerta_coche_abierta.descripcion: A car door wide open across the path. The edge is thin sheet metal; its bottom is a hand's width above the ground.
puerta_coche_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Car door open over the pavement”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.25 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pc”.

portabicicletas_trasero.descripcion: Bikes hung across the back of a car: wheels and handlebars stick out on both sides at waist and chest height. There is nothing underneath.
portabicicletas_trasero.imagen: Footprint of “Rear bike carrier with bikes”: a rectangle, 1.70 by 0.60 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pt”.

carga_saliente_baca.nombre: Load overhanging from a roof rack
carga_saliente_baca.descripcion: A ladder or planks tied to a car roof, sticking out behind at face height. The cane does not find them.
carga_saliente_baca.imagen: Footprint of “Load overhanging from a roof rack”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 1.20 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cs”.

bola_remolque.descripcion: Iron hook with a ball sticking out behind a car at shin height. Small and hard: easy to bang your leg on.
bola_remolque.imagen: Footprint of “Tow ball”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 0.20 metres, hanging 0.35 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Br”.

coche_con_remolque.descripcion: Car with a trailer hitched on. Between the two is the drawbar: a low bar at shin height, so you cannot cut through the gap.
coche_con_remolque.imagen: Footprint of “Car with trailer”: a car at the front and a trailer behind, joined by a narrow drawbar, 1.80 by 7.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

furgoneta_puertas_abiertas.nombre: Delivery van with rear doors open
furgoneta_puertas_abiertas.descripcion: Van being unloaded: both rear doors are open and stick straight out, tall and thin. Between them is the load opening, its floor at knee height.
furgoneta_puertas_abiertas.imagen: Footprint of “Delivery van with rear doors open”: a van with both rear doors open backwards, leaving a gap between them, 2.05 by 6.30 metres, marked with the letters “Fp”.

furgon_capitone.descripcion: Large box van: a square, flat-sided box as tall as a wall, overhanging the cab. It beeps when it reverses.
furgon_capitone.imagen: Footprint of “Luton box van”: a long box at the back and a slightly narrower cab at the front, 2.20 by 6.80 metres, marked with the letters “Fc”.

puesto_rodante_comida.nombre: Food truck with its hatch open
puesto_rodante_comida.descripcion: Parked food truck: a shelf sticks out of one side at chest height with a raised hatch above it as a canopy. You can smell frying and hear the griddle.
puesto_rodante_comida.imagen: Footprint of “Food truck with its hatch open”: a van with its counter and canopy sticking out of the right side, 3.20 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

caravana.descripcion: A towed caravan with smooth plastic and metal walls. At the front is the drawbar: a low iron A-frame with a small wheel, reaching knee height.
caravana.imagen: Footprint of “Caravan”: a box with a pointed drawbar sticking out at the front, 2.30 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

autocaravana_toldo.descripcion: Parked motorhome with its awning out to one side. The awning edge is at head height, held by two thin legs and diagonal guy lines; there are usually a table and chairs underneath.
autocaravana_toldo.imagen: Footprint of “Motorhome with awning out”: the motorhome on the left and the unrolled awning on the right, 4.80 by 7.00 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

carrito_golf.descripcion: Small open electric cart with no doors and a roof on four bars. It makes no noise when it moves.
carrito_golf.imagen: Footprint of “Golf buggy”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

quad.descripcion: Motorbike on four fat, soft wheels, with wide handlebars. Low and square; the tyres are what you touch first.
quad.imagen: Footprint of “Parked quad bike”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.15 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Qu”.

camion_reparto.descripcion: Lorry with a long sheet-metal box. The box starts at chest height: underneath, between the wheels, the cane goes in without touching anything. It beeps when reversing.
camion_reparto.imagen: Footprint of “Box delivery lorry”: a long box at the back and a slightly narrower cab at the front, 2.50 by 8.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

plataforma_elevadora_camion.descripcion: A large horizontal metal plate hanging behind a lorry at waist height while it is unloaded. Its edge is iron and the cane passes underneath.
plataforma_elevadora_camion.imagen: Footprint of “Lorry tail lift”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 1.80 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pe”.

retrovisor_camion.descripcion: Large mirror on an arm sticking out of the side of the cab at face height. If the vehicle is tight against the kerb, it juts over the pavement.
retrovisor_camion.imagen: Footprint of “Protruding lorry or bus mirror”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rc”.

camion_mudanzas_rampa.descripcion: Removal lorry with its doors open and a metal ramp running from the box down to the ground. The ramp is narrow, rings underfoot and has no handrail.
camion_mudanzas_rampa.imagen: Footprint of “Removal lorry with ramp”: a lorry with a narrow ramp running from its back down to the ground, 2.50 by 11.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

camion_hormigonera.descripcion: Lorry with a slowly turning drum: you hear the gravel rolling inside. An iron chute sticks out behind at chest height, caked in concrete.
camion_hormigonera.imagen: Footprint of “Concrete mixer lorry”: a lorry with a narrow chute sticking out at the back, 2.50 by 9.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

camion_grua_estabilizadores.descripcion: Crane lorry at work. Two iron legs stick out of each side and rest on pads on the ground, a long stride from the lorry; the boom swings the load overhead.
camion_grua_estabilizadores.aviso: Crane lorry at work: iron legs at the sides and a load overhead.
camion_grua_estabilizadores.imagen: Footprint of “Crane lorry with outriggers out”: a lorry with four legs sticking out sideways, two on each side, 5.50 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

autobus_urbano_parado.descripcion: Bus standing with its engine running: a long wall of metal and glass. The doors are on the side and open with a hiss of air.
autobus_urbano_parado.imagen: Footprint of “City bus at a stop”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.55 by 12.00 metres, marked with the letters “Au”.

autobus_articulado_trasero.nombre: Articulated bus: rear section with bellows
autobus_articulado_trasero.descripcion: Rear half of an articulated bus. It sits behind the standard bus, joined by soft, pleated rubber bellows, narrower than the body: together they are over eighteen metres long.
autobus_articulado_trasero.imagen: Footprint of “Articulated bus: rear section with bellows”: a long rectangle narrowing at the front, at the bellows, 2.55 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

autocar.descripcion: Touring coach, taller than a city bus: the windows are above head height and the luggage holds are low down along the sides. A single door at the front, with steps.
autocar.imagen: Footprint of “Coach”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.55 by 13.00 metres, marked with the letters “Au”.

trampilla_maletero_autocar.descripcion: The lid of a coach luggage hold swung up and out: a wide metal panel jutting from the side at face height while cases are loaded.
trampilla_maletero_autocar.imagen: Footprint of “Open coach luggage hatch”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.90 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tm”.

microbus_rampa_lateral.descripcion: Accessible minibus with its side door open and a metal ramp down to the pavement. The ramp has edges raised a finger's width.
microbus_rampa_lateral.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible minibus with ramp out”: a minibus with a ramp sticking out of its right side, 3.30 by 7.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

tractor.descripcion: Farm tractor: two huge rear wheels of knobbly rubber, taller than a person, and a narrow bonnet. The cab steps are at knee height.
tractor.imagen: Footprint of “Tractor”: wide at the back, because of the big wheels, and narrow at the front, at the bonnet, 2.40 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

carretilla_bebidas.descripcion: Two-wheeled sack truck stacked chest high with bottle crates, left in the middle of the pavement outside a bar. Push it and the bottles clink and it may tip.
carretilla_bebidas.imagen: Footprint of “Drinks delivery sack truck”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

ambulancia_porton.descripcion: Ambulance standing with its engine running and its rear doors open. The step and the stretcher stick out behind at knee and hip height.
ambulancia_porton.imagen: Footprint of “Ambulance with rear doors open”: a van with a centred projection at the back: the step and the stretcher, 2.10 by 7.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

coche_bomberos.descripcion: Fire engine standing with its engine running. Its sides are corrugated metal shutters, sometimes rolled up, with tools inside; there may be hoses on the ground around it.
coche_bomberos.imagen: Footprint of “Fire engine”: a long box at the back and a slightly narrower cab at the front, 2.50 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

manguera_bomberos.descripcion: Thick, hard hose full of water snaking across the street. It does not block the way, but it is like a round kerb: you must step over it. The ground is wet.
manguera_bomberos.aviso: Hose on the ground: step over it.
manguera_bomberos.imagen: Footprint of “Fire hose on the ground”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 6.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

coche_patrulla.descripcion: Police car standing with its engine running, often up on the pavement or parked askew. It has a light bar on the roof; you can hear the radio inside.
coche_patrulla.imagen: Footprint of “Patrol car standing by”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.85 by 4.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

barredora.descripcion: Road sweeper: you hear it from far off, brushes scraping and fan sucking. The round brushes stick out at ground level in front and throw up water and dust.
barredora.imagen: Footprint of “Road sweeper”: a body with two round brushes sticking out at the front corners, 1.80 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

camion_basura.descripcion: Bin lorry. When stopped it is a wall of metal with an open hopper at the back at waist height. At work it is very noisy: the lift whines and the bin crashes over.
camion_basura.imagen: Footprint of “Bin lorry”: a lorry with its slightly narrower loading hopper at the back, 2.50 by 9.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

carro_barrendero.descripcion: Cart with two plastic bins, wheels and a handle, with the broom and shovel sticking out. The street cleaner leaves it on the pavement while working.
carro_barrendero.imagen: Footprint of “Street cleaner's cart”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

bici_caballete.descripcion: Unlocked bike resting only on its kickstand. Brush against it and it clatters over: the handlebars swing round and the pedal is at shin height.
bici_caballete.imagen: Footprint of “Bike standing on its kickstand”: a long narrow body with the handlebars across it, 0.62 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

bici_carga.descripcion: Long bike with a big wooden box at the front for children or parcels. The box is hip high and is the first thing you meet.
bici_carga.imagen: Footprint of “Cargo bike”: narrow at the back with a wide box at the front, 0.90 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

bici_remolque_infantil.descripcion: Bike with a fabric trailer hitched behind, low and wider than the bike. A bar near the ground joins the two; a thin flag pole rises from the trailer.
bici_remolque_infantil.imagen: Footprint of “Bike with child trailer”: a bicycle at the front and a wide, low trailer behind, 0.80 by 3.30 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

triciclo_adaptado.descripcion: Adult tricycle: one wheel in front and two behind with a big basket between them. It does not fall over when touched; at the back it is as wide as a wheelchair.
triciclo_adaptado.imagen: Footprint of “Adult adapted tricycle”: wide at the back, with two wheels and a basket, and narrow at the front, 0.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

bicicleta_tumbada.descripcion: Bike fallen across the path: a low tangle of wheels, pedals and handlebars, below knee height. The cane gets caught in the spokes.
bicicleta_tumbada.imagen: Footprint of “Bike lying on the ground”: an irregular patch of wheels, frame and handlebars, 1.75 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

moto_grande_maletas.descripcion: Large touring motorbike with two hard panniers at the sides and a top box behind: at the back it is as wide as a doorway. Engine and exhaust may be hot.
moto_grande_maletas.imagen: Footprint of “Large motorbike with panniers”: a narrow body with two wide panniers at the back and the handlebars at the front, 1.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mg”.

ciclomotor_reparto.descripcion: Food delivery moped with a square box at the back at chest height. It is left on the pavement for a moment, often with the engine running.
ciclomotor_reparto.imagen: Footprint of “Delivery moped with box”: a narrow body with a square box at the back and the handlebars at the front, 0.70 by 1.95 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

remolque_suelto.descripcion: Unhitched goods trailer. The box is waist high, but at the front is the drawbar: an iron bar a hand's width above the ground, resting on a jockey wheel.
remolque_suelto.imagen: Footprint of “Unhitched trailer with drawbar”: a box with a pointed drawbar sticking out at the front, 1.50 by 3.30 metres, marked with the letters “Rs”.

montamuebles.descripcion: Removal hoist: a small trailer with an aluminium ladder slanting up to a balcony. The ladder crosses the pavement diagonally at head height.
montamuebles.aviso: Furniture hoist: a slanting ladder crosses overhead.
montamuebles.imagen: Footprint of “Furniture hoist”: a T shape, 1.80 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

cuba_escombros.descripcion: Thick sheet-metal builder's skip with sloping ends and its rim at chest height. The lugs the lorry lifts it by stick out of its sides.
cuba_escombros.imagen: Footprint of “Builder's skip”: a rectangle with sloping ends and lifting lugs sticking out of the sides, 1.80 by 3.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

contenedor_maritimo.descripcion: Huge corrugated steel box as tall as a room, used as a site store. It booms when struck; the doors, at one end, have upright locking bars.
contenedor_maritimo.imagen: Footprint of “Shipping container”: a rectangle, 2.44 by 6.06 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

caseta_obra.descripcion: Prefabricated metal cabin with a door and a loose step in front. It is the site office or changing room; the air conditioner hums on one wall.
caseta_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Site cabin”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

deposito_gasoil.descripcion: Sheet-metal tank lying on a drip tray, with a hose and nozzle hanging from it. It smells of diesel and the ground around is slippery.
deposito_gasoil.imagen: Footprint of “Site diesel tank”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.30 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Dg”.

silo_mortero.descripcion: Very tall sheet-metal cylinder on four legs, standing in the road next to a building site. The outlet hangs between the legs at chest height and there are hoses on the ground.
silo_mortero.imagen: Footprint of “Mortar silo”: a square: the four legs of the silo, 2.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sm”.

grupo_electrogeno.descripcion: Site generator on a trailer: a chest-high metal box with a low drawbar at the front. When running it gives a loud, steady engine noise and blows hot air.
grupo_electrogeno.imagen: Footprint of “Towable generator”: a box with a pointed drawbar sticking out at the front, 1.40 by 3.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ge”.

miniexcavadora.descripcion: Small digger on rubber tracks. The folded arm sticks out in front with the bucket resting on the ground; the elbow of the arm is at head height.
miniexcavadora.imagen: Footprint of “Parked mini digger”: a T shape, 1.50 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

plaza_bateria.descripcion: Painted markings of a bay at right angles to the aisle. You cannot feel them underfoot: they show where cars go, side by side, nose or tail in.
plaza_bateria.imagen: Footprint of “Perpendicular parking bay”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

plaza_linea.descripcion: Markings of a bay along the kerb. Cars stand one behind another, tight against the pavement.
plaza_linea.imagen: Footprint of “Parallel parking bay”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

plaza_espiga.descripcion: Markings of a bay slanted to the aisle. Cars stand diagonally: their corners make a saw-tooth edge as you follow them with the cane.
plaza_espiga.imagen: Footprint of “Echelon parking bay”: a slanted parallelogram, 4.00 by 4.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

plaza_movilidad_reducida.descripcion: Reserved bay, wider than the others: beside it is a clear strip for opening the door fully and getting a wheelchair out, linked to the pavement by a dropped kerb.
plaza_movilidad_reducida.imagen: Footprint of “Disabled parking bay”: a rectangle, 3.70 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

tope_rueda.descripcion: Low rubber or concrete bar bolted at the end of the bay, a hand's width high. With the car away it lies alone on the ground: a trip hazard.
tope_rueda.imagen: Footprint of “Wheel stop”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

isleta_aparcamiento.descripcion: Long, round-ended island between rows of bays, edged by a kerb a hand's width high and filled with earth, gravel or plants. Step up onto it or go round.
isleta_aparcamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Kerbed car park island”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 5.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ia”.

bolardo_abatible_plaza.descripcion: Iron hoop in the middle of a reserved bay, knee high. With its key it folds flat to the ground and lets you through; raised, it keeps the bay.
bolardo_abatible_plaza.imagen: Footprint of “Fold-down parking post”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

cepo_rueda.descripcion: Iron clamp fixed to the wheel of a badly parked car: a triangular piece sticking out from the side at shin height.
cepo_rueda.imagen: Footprint of “Wheel clamp”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.50 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

guardarrail_bajo.descripcion: Band of corrugated steel on short posts, knee to thigh high, closing off the edge of the car park. You can trail it with the cane; the edges are sharp.
guardarrail_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low crash barrier”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Gb”.

cadena_entre_postes.descripcion: Chain hanging slack between two short posts, closing off a car park or a passage. It is at knee or thigh height and the cane may pass underneath without touching it.
cadena_entre_postes.imagen: Footprint of “Chain between posts”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.08 metres, hanging 0.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

pilar_marquesina_solar.descripcion: Steel post of the canopy shading the bays, set on a concrete block that sticks out at shin height. Above, the solar panels hum slightly.
pilar_marquesina_solar.imagen: Footprint of “Car park canopy post”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

recinto_carritos.descripcion: Shelter open at the front where supermarket trolleys are left: tubular rails on both sides and a roof. Inside, the nested trolleys rattle.
recinto_carritos.imagen: Footprint of “Trolley shelter”: a U open at the front, 2.50 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rc”.

anclajes_motos.descripcion: Row of low iron rails at mid-shin height for chaining motorbikes to. With no bikes there, the rails stand alone and trip you.
anclajes_motos.imagen: Footprint of “Motorbike parking with anchor rails”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 4.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

taquilla_bicicleta.descripcion: Wedge-shaped metal locker that holds one bike: wide at the door and narrow at the back. Several together form a fan or a row.
taquilla_bicicleta.imagen: Footprint of “Bike locker”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.90 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

bancada_bicis_dos_pisos.descripcion: Two-level bike rack: bikes in channels below and another row above on pull-out rails. The upper rails and handlebars are at head height.
bancada_bicis_dos_pisos.imagen: Footprint of “Two-tier bike rack”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

estacion_bici_publica.descripcion: Row of bike share docks: low posts every good half metre, some with bikes locked in, and a terminal at one end. It beeps when a bike is released.
estacion_bici_publica.imagen: Footprint of “Bike share docking station”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 7.50 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

estacion_patinetes.descripcion: Fixed base with low rails where hire scooters slot in, all upright in a row. The handlebars are at chest height; the empty rails are at ground level.
estacion_patinetes.imagen: Footprint of “Shared e-scooter dock”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

rampa_aparcamiento.descripcion: Grooved concrete ramp that cars drive up and down. The ground slopes steeply and there is no footway: you hear the echo of the car park and engines approaching.
rampa_aparcamiento.aviso: Vehicle ramp: no footway here and cars may come.
rampa_aparcamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Car park entry ramp”: a rectangle, 3.50 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

junta_dilatacion.descripcion: Metal strip crossing the car park floor from side to side. It sounds different underfoot and is slippery when wet; cars make it clunk twice as they cross.
junta_dilatacion.imagen: Footprint of “Metal expansion joint”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Jd”.

canaleta_rejilla.descripcion: Narrow channel with an iron grating across the foot of the ramp to collect water. The cane tip slips between the bars and, if a section is missing, there is a gap.
canaleta_rejilla.aviso: Drain grating: the cane tip may slip in.
canaleta_rejilla.imagen: Footprint of “Drainage channel with grating”: a rectangle, 3.50 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

banda_reductora_goma.descripcion: Rubber hump bolted across the lane, three fingers high. Underfoot it feels like a rounded step; cars thud over it.
banda_reductora_goma.imagen: Footprint of “Rubber speed bump”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

barrera_aparcamiento.descripcion: Long, light arm across the lane at waist height, coming out of a metal cabinet at one side. The cane passes underneath. It rises with a hum and a clunk when it opens.
barrera_aparcamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Car park barrier”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ba”.

cancela_corredera.descripcion: Barred gate sliding sideways on a floor rail to close the vehicle entrance. It hums and rolls as it moves; the rail, a finger high, is always there.
cancela_corredera.imagen: Footprint of “Motorised sliding gate”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

columna_tiques.descripcion: Metal column at car window height, next to the barrier. It has a big button, a slot the ticket comes out of and an intercom; it beeps and speaks.
columna_tiques.imagen: Footprint of “Car park ticket column”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.35 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

cajero_aparcamiento.descripcion: Pay machine by the pedestrian exit: insert the ticket, pay with coins or card and it returns it validated. It has keys, slots and a tray at the bottom for change.
cajero_aparcamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Car park pay station”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

lector_matricula.descripcion: Slim post with a camera, just before the barrier. Thin and alone in the middle of the island: easy to miss with the cane.
lector_matricula.imagen: Footprint of “Number plate reader post”: a circle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Lm”.

garita_control.descripcion: Small metal and glass booth for the attendant, on the island between the way in and the way out. It has a sliding hatch at chest height.
garita_control.imagen: Footprint of “Attendant's booth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

arco_galibo.descripcion: Horizontal bar hung on two chains over the entrance to warn tall vehicles. It is at crown-of-the-head height: a tall person will touch it.
arco_galibo.imagen: Footprint of “Height restriction bar”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 2.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ag”.

espejo_convexo.descripcion: Round, domed mirror on an arm at the corner of a ramp or an exit so that drivers can see. It sticks out from the wall at head height.
espejo_convexo.imagen: Footprint of “Convex corner mirror”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.60 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ec”.

avisador_salida_vehiculos.descripcion: Box with a light and a beeper above a garage door. When a car is about to come out it gives two quick high beeps over and over: stop and let it cross the pavement.
avisador_salida_vehiculos.imagen: Footprint of “Vehicle exit warning sounder”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.15 metres, hanging 2.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “As”.

surtidor_combustible.descripcion: Filling station pump on an island a hand's width high: a cabinet with rubber hoses hanging on both sides and the nozzles at waist height. It smells of petrol.
surtidor_combustible.imagen: Footprint of “Fuel pump”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

arco_protector_surtidor.descripcion: Thick iron tube bent into a hoop and fixed in the ground, knee high, at the corners of the pump island. Solid: it does not move.
arco_protector_surtidor.imagen: Footprint of “Pump protection hoop”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.09 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

jaula_bombonas.descripcion: Iron mesh cage with gas cylinders inside, next to the filling station shop. Touch it and the mesh rattles and the cylinders ring like hollow metal.
jaula_bombonas.imagen: Footprint of “Gas cylinder cage”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Jb”.

tunel_lavado.descripcion: Car wash: two walls with rollers and jets that the car passes between. When running it is very noisy, it splashes and the ground at each end is wet.
tunel_lavado.imagen: Footprint of “Car wash tunnel”: a U open at the front, 4.50 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tl”.

box_lavado_manual.descripcion: Bay open at the front with metal walls where you wash your own car with a pressure lance. The floor is a wet, soapy grating.
box_lavado_manual.imagen: Footprint of “Jet wash bay”: a U open at the front, 4.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

aspirador_gasolinera.descripcion: Fat metal column with a long corrugated hose on a hook. Put a coin in and it roars for a minute; the hose is often left lying on the ground.
aspirador_gasolinera.imagen: Footprint of “Forecourt vacuum”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ag”.

poste_aire_agua.descripcion: Post with the air hose for tyres and a water tap. In use, the compressor chugs and beeps when it reaches pressure.
poste_aire_agua.imagen: Footprint of “Air and water point”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.
